summary: Iteration 11 — verified E1's three bug fixes end-to-end. Backend 19/19 passed (backend_iteration11_test.py) covering task/client/invoice create + credentials with file_type='pdf'/file_name + /api/transcribe with a real 0.5s WAV (Whisper returned success:true). Frontend (mobile web 390x844, logged in as TEST_DEMO_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD): (a) BUG3a — Planner → add-task-fab → save-task-btn ⇒ 'Task added ✓' celebration overlay rendered and new task appears in list. (b) BUG3b — Clients tab → add-client-btn → save-client-btn ⇒ 'Client added ✓' celebration and 'TEST_iter11 PW Client' visible in participants list. (c) BUG3c — /invoice/new → generate-invoice-btn ⇒ 'Invoice created ✨' celebration seen and router.back() executed. (d) BUG1 — Credentials Add Document modal now shows three attach buttons: cred-camera ('Photo'), cred-gallery ('Gallery'), cred-file ('PDF / File'). Backend also confirmed the credentials POST accepts file_type='pdf' and file_name and returns them on GET. Regression: /api/dashboard/stats, /outstanding, /upcoming, /invoices, /clients, /credentials all 200. No red screens, no crashes. Only carryover RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) and the expo-notifications web-only warning — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated on web — use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking carryover from earlier iterations.
'props.pointerEvents' deprecated on web — use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Celebration.tsx:31 (Burst passes pointerEvents='none' as prop). Non-blocking.
'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — expected web-preview only warning.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add a stable testID (e.g. 'celebration-overlay') to the Celebration overlay in /app/frontend/src/components/Celebration.tsx so automated tests don't have to text-scrape the message. Currently detected by searching page text for 'Task added' / 'Client added' / 'Invoice created' which is brittle.

critical_code_review_comments: planner.tsx:44-55 — addTask now wraps api.createTask in try/catch, calls celebrate('Task added ✓', {sound:true}) on success, and Alert.alert on failure. State reset (title/time/type/modal) happens BEFORE celebrate so the sheet closes and the celebration overlay is visible on top of the list — good UX.

ClientFormSheet.tsx:77-94 — save() correctly gates on name.trim(), calls onSaved()+onClose() then celebrate() (so parent list refreshes underneath the overlay). Both create and edit paths surface Alert.alert on error. isEdit branch reuses the same celebrate call with 'Client updated ✓'.

invoice/new.tsx:112-156 — save() shows loading state, catches errors with Alert.alert, calls celebrate() then router.back(). The reminder scheduling is wrapped in its own try/catch so a notification-permission failure never blocks the success feedback. setSaving(false) is only invoked in the catch branch — success path relies on unmount from router.back(), which is correct.

credentials.tsx:54-67 — pickDocument uses expo-document-picker with type=['application/pdf','image/*'], reads base64 via FileSystem, detects PDF by mimeType or filename extension, then stores file_type + file_name. Error path Alerts with a friendly message. openPdf (line 69-82) writes to cache and uses expo-sharing (fallback to Linking) — appropriate native-only path (won't run on web preview but doesn't crash).

server.py:1299-1333 — Credential model now includes file_type ('image'|'pdf') defaulting to 'image' and file_name (default ''). CredentialCreate mirrors these fields. Verified via backend test that POST accepts + returns both, and they persist through the list endpoint.

server.py:245-267 — /api/transcribe correctly decodes base64, restricts format to the Whisper-allowed set (mp3/mp4/mpeg/mpga/m4a/wav/webm — defaults to m4a if invalid), writes to a NamedTemporaryFile, calls OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe, and cleans up in a finally block. Verified with a real 16 kHz mono 0.5s WAV containing a 440 Hz tone — returned {success:true, text:''} (Whisper appropriately outputs empty text for a pure tone — 200 status validates the integration).

Celebration.tsx:31,111-120 — overlay is rendered only when visible=true and auto-dismisses via withDelay(1400,…) → runOnJS(hide). No testID present on the overlay/badge/message — recommend adding testID='celebration-overlay' to line 112 for future test stability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 flows: task-create+celebration+list, client-create+celebration+list, invoice-create+celebration, credentials modal shows cred-file PDF/File button alongside cred-camera+cred-gallery)
